scenarios.title: VERBATIM in-repo smoke fixture
scenarios.text: Surface metal nonmetal mine conveyor tail pulley has exposed moving machine parts and the guard is missing.

scenarios.title: same hazard, natural rewording
scenarios.text: At the surface pit, the tail pulley on the conveyor is not guarded and the moving parts can be reached from the walkway.

scenarios.title: same hazard, inspector shorthand
scenarios.text: conveyor tail pulley unguarded, surface mine, miners walk right by it

scenarios.title: VERBATIM-style LOTO fixture
scenarios.text: A technician is servicing the press and hazardous energy has not been isolated or locked out.

scenarios.title: same LOTO hazard, reworded
scenarios.text: The maintenance guy had the press apart with the power still on and nothing locked.

scenarios.title: VERBATIM-style safe-state fixture
scenarios.text: The equipment was locked out and zero energy was verified before servicing began.

scenarios.title: same safe state, reworded
scenarios.text: Before they opened it up, the crew put their locks on and checked it was dead.
